# Results

* `tables/main_results.md`: comparison with existing methods (Tables 1-3 of the paper).
* `tables/ablation.md`: component controls and internal controls (Tables 4-5).
* `tables/collected.md`: generated by `scripts/collect_results.py` from the test logs.
* `figures/`: framework and diagnostic figures of the paper.
* `logs/`: `test_<dataset>[_to_<target>]_<shot>shot.txt` written by `scripts/test.py`.
* `save/`, `pretrain/`, `semantic/`: training checkpoints, pre-training runs and generated phrases (not tracked).

| Figure | Content |
|:--|:--|
| `figures/motivation.png` | Fig. 1, support-evidence contamination and the rejection margin |
| `figures/framework.png` | Fig. 2, overall framework |
| `figures/gated_attention.png` | Fig. 3, RL-gated attention block |
| `figures/semantic_purification.png` | Fig. 4, complementary semantic purification |
| `figures/counterfactual_gating.png` | Fig. 5, counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating |
| `figures/evidence_margins.png` | signed-margin distributions of intrinsic and nuisance evidence |
| `figures/sensitivity.png` | sensitivity to the allocation temperature, anchor coefficient and nuisance-cost weight |
| `figures/policy_diagnostics.png` | gradient-covariance trace and clipping statistics |
| `figures/tsne.png` | t-SNE of query features |
| `figures/attention.png` | attention patterns of the baseline, purification alone, gating alone and DVLA-RL++ |
